prediction_contract.description: Signed displacement and final velocity under constant force for the supplied duration.
prediction_contract.initial_position: Displacement is relative to the initial position.

sampling.uniform: Independent uniform draws across all input ranges.
sampling.from_rest: Exactly zero initial velocity; uniform force and duration.
sampling.zero_force: Exactly zero force; uniform initial velocity and duration.
sampling.static_threshold: Rest, with signed force within 0.2 N of either static threshold; uniform duration.
sampling.stopping_boundary: Sample velocity and duration uniformly; choose nominal stopping time within 5% of duration and derive force; reject out-of-range forces.

split_policy: Independent examples with identical category proportions per split; exact duplicate input tuples are excluded across all splits. No trajectories are sampled.
normalization: None. Values retain physical units. Fit any future normalization using only train.csv.
evaluation_scope: In-range synthetic examples from the reference physics; not an extrapolation or real-world validation dataset. Keep test.csv unused until final evaluation.
